proxy.title: Proxy Configuration
proxy.urlKeepPlaceholder: Enter new URL to replace {{host}} (credentials not shown)

proxy.hint: Changes apply on the next session start, not to a running connection. The proxy must be real and reachable — an unreachable value blocks QR delivery: on whatsapp-web.js the start returns 504; on Baileys the start succeeds and the session keeps retrying.

unlink.incomplete: The session stopped locally, but the logout operation is incomplete — the device may still be linked. Start the session and retry the logout.

session.label: WhatsApp Session

single.title: Check Single Account
single.tooLong: More than {{max}} digits is not one phone number. Check one number at a time.
single.silent: Completely Silent: This query queries WhatsApp's registration registry directly. The contact receives no notification, sound, or message.

preview.prefixed: Will check as: +{{number}} (10 digits → auto-prefixed with 91)
preview.kept: Will check as: +{{number}} (12 digits → kept as-is)

prefixHint.single: Adds +91 to 10-digit numbers and to 11 digits with a leading 0. Numbers with + or 00 stay as typed.
prefixHint.bulk: Adds +91 to 10-digit numbers (e.g. 96...) and to 11 digits with a leading 0. Numbers with + or 00 stay as typed.
prefixHint.off: Numbers are checked as typed, digits only, so include the country code.

bulk.title: Bulk Number Checker
bulk.delayHint: Waits between lookups to stay under the gateway's request limit (100 a minute by default). The run stops if the gateway refuses further lookups.
bulk.numbersLabel: Numbers to Check (One per line or comma-separated)
bulk.numbersHint: Paste phone numbers with the country code, one per line or comma-separated. Up to {{max}} numbers per run.
bulk.tooMany: Too many numbers: {{parsed}} parsed, at most {{max}} per run. Remove {{excess}} to start.
bulk.tooLong: Left out, more than {{max}} digits (not one number): {{count}}. Put each number on its own line.
bulk.exportHint: The file holds every digit. A spreadsheet may show long numbers as 9.19612E+11 or drop a leading zero; import the file and set the Phone Number column to Text to keep them unchanged.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.subtitle: Configure server, database, cache, storage, and engine settings

database.title: Database Configuration
database.builtInDesc: OpenWA will manage a PostgreSQL container for you
database.schemaDesc: PostgreSQL schema (ignored for SQLite). Default 'public'. The schema must already exist.
database.sslDesc: Enable TLS/SSL for secure database connections
database.sslRejectUnauthorizedDesc: Reject self-signed or invalid certificates. Turn off for managed Postgres with self-signed certs (Supabase, Heroku, Render, Railway).
database.migrationsStatus: Pending migrations are applied automatically at startup
database.migrationsHint: Migrations are managed automatically. Use CLI for manual migrations.

engine.title: WhatsApp Engine
engine.headlessDesc: Run the browser without a visible UI (recommended for production).
engine.noBrowser: This engine connects over WebSocket — it has no browser, so there are no headless or browser-argument settings. The active engine is applied after a restart.
engine.restartNote: Switching the engine takes effect after a server restart.

redis.title: Redis
redis.enableDesc: Used for caching, BullMQ queues, rate-limit counters, and multi-node WebSocket fan-out
redis.builtInDesc: OpenWA will manage a Redis container for you
redis.queueDesc: Use message queues for reliable message and webhook delivery
redis.disabledDesc: Enable Redis for caching, BullMQ message queues, rate-limit counters, and multi-node WebSocket fan-out.
redis.bullMqUrlHint: Open it with an ADMIN API key — a browser tab can't authenticate.

storage.title: Storage Configuration
storage.builtInDesc: OpenWA will manage a MinIO (S3-compatible) container for you
storage.endpointHint: For MinIO or other S3-compatible services

infrastructure.envPinNote: Pinned by the environment variable {{name}} — this is the running value; dashboard changes won't apply until that variable is unset.
infrastructure.envPinFlagNote: Pinned by the environment variable {{name}}: the built-in container still starts at every boot while it is set to true and this service is in use, even with this toggle off.
infrastructure.pendingRestartNote: Saved, but not applied yet — restart the server for this change to take effect.
infrastructure.pendingBuiltInNote: Saved, but not applied yet: the server runs with an external service now, and a restart switches it to the built-in container.
infrastructure.pendingExternalNote: Saved, but not applied yet: the server runs with the built-in container now, and a restart switches it to an external service.

migration.title: Heads up — this changes the data backend
migration.dbWarning: The new database starts empty. Download a backup of your current data now (while still on the old database), then restore it after the restart.
migration.storageWarning: Existing media files are not moved to the new storage backend automatically; they'll remain in the old location.
migration.backupHint: Export all data as JSON before switching databases, then import it after the switch. Webhook signing secrets, custom webhook headers and proxy credentials are not included; re-enter them after restoring. Integration instance secrets and settings are included in plaintext, so store the file securely and delete it after restoring.
migration.exportPartial: {{count}} attachment payload(s) exceeded the export media budget and were saved as placeholders. The messages restore; their media does not.
migration.importConfirm: Importing will REPLACE all current data with the backup ({{rows}} rows). This cannot be undone. Continue?
migration.invalidFile: That file isn't a valid OpenWA data backup.
migration.importTooLarge: Backup is too large for the request limit. Increase BODY_SIZE_LIMIT on the server and try again.

restart.idleDesc:
Configuration has been saved to .env.generated.
A server restart is required to apply the changes.

restart.successMsg: Server is back online! The page will reload automatically.
restart.errorMsg: Server did not respond. Please check the Docker logs and restart manually.
restart.outcomeUnknown: The proxy returned an error before the server answered, so it is not known whether the restart is in progress. Reload in a minute to check.

infrastructure.statusLoadError: Couldn't load the current infrastructure status. Refresh to try again.
